name: Japanese Cartoons
overview: Scripture warns against the creation and fixation on images or likenesses, emphasizing that God revealed Himself without any form or similitude (Deuteronomy 4:15; Exodus 20:4). Those who craft or worship graven images are described as vain and misguided, lacking true understanding (Isaiah 44:9; Acts 17:29). Believers are called to guard their eyes and hearts, setting no wicked thing before them, and focusing on the light of God's truth to fill their lives (Psalms 101:3; Matthew 6:22). This calls for discernment regarding visual media, including Japanese cartoons, ensuring that what we view aligns with a Christ-centered perspective and does not lead us away from the pure worship of God.
